gaps.title: V03 unpinned retrieval sites
gaps.statement: Five retrieval sites use the default Hub revision: root config.json, graphs and tokenizer, codec files, denoiser and an optional voices_v3_turbo.json override. With a local backbone directory and onnx_dir, four can resolve locally by configuration; the codec cannot (G04).

gaps.title: V04 codec_dir not forwarded by the public constructor
gaps.statement: The engine accepts codec_dir but the v3 Turbo wrapper passes only checkpoint, onnx_repo, onnx_dir, onnx_subfolder and threads. Configuration alone cannot route codec reads to a pinned local directory. Options O1 offline mode with a seeded Hub cache (unverified), O2 direct private engine use (adapter), O3 patch or fork (not admitted), O4 accept unpinned execution egress (rejected as identity loss).

gaps.title: Rights are publisher declarations only
gaps.statement: Model and codec repositories list no LICENSE or NOTICE file at the pinned revisions; Apache-2.0 appears in card front matter. Training data pipeline is not public. No independent clearance exists for weights, codec, dependencies, browser, FFmpeg or fonts.

gaps.title: Preset consent and identity are unverified
gaps.statement: Preset entries carry no consent or provenance field. The card documents 23 voices with default Minh Quan at SDK 3.7.1; the pin ships 25 voices with default Hai Dang and an alias. Bundled sample clips ship in the package data but are not part of the fixed-preset path.

gaps.title: Python dependency footprint and licences unknown
gaps.statement: Core metadata requires gradio and librosa; versions float; sea-g2p latest is 0.10.0 above the 0.9.1 floor. No resolver run, so peak storage is not computable.

gaps.title: Browser download size and terms unobserved
gaps.statement: Source pins chrome-headless-shell 152.0.7977.30 as download of last resort; resolution can select an unpinned system Chrome first. The download host is outside the read allowlist, so size is unobserved.

gaps.title: FFmpeg unresolved on PATH and build unknown
gaps.statement: Get-Command ffmpeg and ffprobe resolve nothing on the current PATH; this is not a whole-machine absence claim. Render needs a libx264 capable build; its licence terms depend on the chosen build.

gaps.title: Vietnamese font coverage may trigger render-time font egress
gaps.statement: The resolver embeds Latin subsets for bundled families and fetches other subsets or families from Google Fonts; declared local font faces are recognised, but whether that avoids all fetches for Vietnamese text was not proven.

gaps.title: HyperFrames implicit effects and their opt-outs
gaps.statement: Source shows .env loading from the working directory, default telemetry with HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK opt-out, update check and detached installer with HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK and HYPERFRAMES_NO_AUTO_INSTALL opt-outs, skills update check with HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS, and user-home cache and config writes. Controls were read, not exercised.

gaps.title: Resource fit is a snapshot, not a measurement
gaps.statement: Free RAM was 2.51 GiB of 15.69 GiB at probe time; D drive free 24.2 GiB, C drive 16.82 GiB. Peak RAM, elapsed time and CPU throughput are unmeasured; published benchmarks are GPU desktop figures and are not transferred to this hybrid laptop CPU.

gaps.title: Execution cost and alternatives remain unpriced

gaps.title: Audio mux path in the renderer was not read
gaps.statement: How the renderer muxes the WAV into MP4, padding behaviour and A/V duration agreement were not read; they remain joined-acceptance obligations.
